WITH annual_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_minimum AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT ac.Segment, ac.total_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption ac
    JOIN segment_minimum sm
      ON ac.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND ac.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
),
segment_average AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

WITH segment_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment
FROM (SELECT Segment FROM segment_pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment
FROM (SELECT Segment FROM segment_pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1);	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
